title: An improved RT-qPCR method for direct quantification of enveloped RNA viruses

steps.title: Isolate plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Propagate the template vectors in Escherichia coli and isolate plasmid DNA using the E.Z.N.A.® Plasmid DNA Mini Kit (or any equivalent plasmid purification kit).

steps.title: Linearize plasmid with EcoRI
steps.instruction: Set up a 50 µL EcoRI digestion: 5 µL 10× FastDigest buffer, 5 µg plasmid (100 ng/µL), 2 µL EcoRI, add nuclease‑free water to 50 µL. Incubate 1 h at 37 °C. Separate the linearized plasmid on a 0.8 % agarose gel in 1×TAE, extract the DNA with an agarose‑gel extraction kit (or purify directly with a PCR purification kit). Store the purified linear DNA at –20 °C.

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 µL 10× FastDigest buffer, 5 µg plasmid, 2 µL EcoRI and water to 50 µL.
Run 0.8 % agarose gel in 1×TAE, extract DNA.

steps.title: In vitro transcribe RNA
steps.instruction: Assemble a 50 µL IVT reaction: 500 ng linearized plasmid (10 ng/µL), 10 µL 5× transcription buffer, 4 µL 25 mM NTP mix (2 mM each), 1.25 µL RiboLock RNase inhibitor (1 U/µL, 20 U/µL final), 1.5 µL T7 RNA polymerase (0.6 U/µL, 20 U/µL final), add nuclease‑free water to 50 µL. Incubate 2 h at 37 °C. Add 2 µL DNase I, mix, and incubate a further 15 min at 37 °C to remove the DNA template.

substeps.instruction: Mix linearized plasmid, transcription buffer, NTPs, RiboLock, T7 polymerase and water to 50 µL.
Add 2 µL DNase I, incubate 15 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Purify RNA by phenol‑chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL nuclease‑free water to the IVT reaction, then 300 µL acidic phenol (pH 4.3) and 60 µL chloroform (chloroform volume = 1/5 phenol volume). Vortex 15 s at full speed, centrifuge 10 000 g for 15 min at room temperature. Transfer the aqueous phase, add 300 µL isopropanol, and let RNA precipitate for 30 min at room temperature. Centrifuge 16 000 g for 30 min, wash the pellet with 1 mL 80 % ethanol (vortex), centrifuge 16 000 g for 10 min, remove supernatant, air‑dry the pellet, dissolve in nuclease‑free water, quantify with Qubit BR RNA assay, optionally check on agarose gel, and store at –80 °C. Typical yield: 40–70 µg RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL nuclease‑free water to the IVT reaction.
Add 300 µL acidic phenol and 60 µL chloroform.
Transfer aqueous phase, add 300 µL isopropanol, incubate 30 min RT.
Wash pellet with 1 mL 80 % ethanol, vortex.
Dissolve in nuclease‑free water, quantify with Qubit BR RNA assay.

steps.title: Prepare virus samples for RT‑qPCR
steps.instruction: Thaw virus samples at room temperature while mixing, then keep on ice. Transfer 100 µL of each sample to a new tube, add 1 µL chloroform, vortex 15 s, incubate 5 min at room temperature, centrifuge 1 min at 10 000 g, and keep the cleared supernatant on ice for downstream RT‑qPCR.

substeps.instruction: Thaw samples at RT with mixing, then place on ice.
Transfer 100 µL to a new tube.

steps.title: Run RT‑qPCR
steps.instruction: Set up one‑step RT‑qPCR reactions using UltraPlex® 1‑Step ToughMix® Low ROX™ (4X) together with the primers and hydrolysis probes listed in Table 1 (Phi6 P2 and Firefly Luciferase). Include the RNA standards and the firefly luciferase control RNA, load reactions into a QuantStudio™ 3 (or equivalent) Real‑Time PCR system and run the manufacturer’s cycling program for one‑step RT‑qPCR.

steps.title: Analyze qPCR data
steps.instruction: Use QuantStudio Design and Analysis software v1.5.1 (or equivalent) to generate the standard curve from the RNA standards. Calculate the quantity per well with the formula: Quantity per well = (Cq – Yintercept) / slope.
